rootCause.adminClientKeys: The production Admin API allow-list was missing the current WEBUI client key.
rootCause.webClientBase: The production WEB runtime had ECOREX_WEB_CLIENT_BASE=https://mvdcm.ecoremedia.net/client, missing the /ecorex-agent prefix. WEB /api/models could not validate enterprise tokens, so send preflight reported no available model.
rootCause.browserBridge: The served WEB bridge did not expose window.ECOREX_WEB_CLIENT_BASE, so re-login could fall back to local WEB auth instead of Admin enterprise auth.

serverChanges.change: Added current/compatible WEBUI client keys to ECOREX_CLIENT_EVENT_KEYS.
Injected window.ECOREX_WEB_CLIENT_BASE and window.ECOREX_WEB_CLIENT_KEYS into the served WEB bridge.

verification.adminModelConfig: All 9 user/key combinations returned HTTP 200, configured=true.
verification.webApiModels: All 9 user/key combinations returned HTTP 200 with configured providers deepseek, gemini, openai, doubao.

operatorNote: Users with the old page already open should refresh the WEBUI page and log in again so the new bridge script is loaded.
